shots.title: One Hard Source
shots.brief: A single bare, small, hard light close to the subject. Let the shadow be ugly and sharp.
shots.constraint: One source, and it must be hard enough to throw a defined shadow.
shots.review: How far did the shadow travel, and did you fight it or use it?

shots.title: Leading Lines
shots.brief: Find lines in the space that point at your subject. Use all of them.
shots.constraint: At least two lines must converge on the subject.
shots.review: Do the lines actually point anywhere, or were you forcing it?

shots.title: Headroom
shots.brief: Same subject, five takes. Vary the space above their head from cramped to generous.
shots.constraint: Keep the head in frame in every take.
shots.review: At what point did extra headroom stop feeling like empty space and start feeling like intent?

shots.title: Thirds
shots.brief: Place your subject on a third line, horizontally and vertically. Both at once.
shots.constraint: Subject sits on an intersection of thirds lines.
shots.review: Did the rule help, or did you want to break it immediately?

shots.title: Full Manual
shots.brief: Shoot one shot with focus, exposure, and white balance all locked manually. Nothing auto.
shots.constraint: No auto anything, for one take.
shots.review: Which manual setting did you have to think hardest about?

shots.title: Pan Reveal
shots.brief: Start on something empty, pan across to the subject. The subject is not visible at the start.
shots.constraint: The reveal happens inside the take, not across a cut.
shots.review: Did the pan lead the eye, or did it feel like searching?

shots.title: Repetition With A Break
shots.brief: Frame a row of similar things. One of them is different. Compose so the break is the subject.
shots.constraint: The odd one out is the compositional anchor.
shots.review: Did the eye land on the break straight away, or did the pattern swallow it?

shots.title: Negative Space
shots.brief: Put a small subject in a big space. Let the frame breathe. The subject is under 20% of the image.
shots.constraint: The subject must occupy under a fifth of the frame.
shots.review: Is there a direction the subject is looking, and did the space agree with it?
